name: harvesttrack
description: HarvestTrack — crop lifecycle, harvest forecasting and weather-risk platform

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
